Sam (CEO): Quick weekly exec snapshot — please skim. TL;DR: 1) Dedicated EU launch targeted next week (canary starts Tue), 2) p95 latency improvement target = -20% by end of Q, 3) update hosted API data retention policy (details below). All-hands Friday 9:00am PT for Q&A.

Priya (VP Product): Docs PR is green, feature-flag checklist is in the repo. Need confirmation on rollout window and customer comms.

Liu (VP Eng): Autoscaler tuning patch merged to main; canary config for EU will run at 02:00 UTC tomorrow. I'll monitor warm-up and KV cache hit rate.

Nadia (Head CS): Noted on retention policy. I'll draft migration emails for impacted customers and own outreach to top-10. Any legal/privacy notes to include?

ops-bot: Daily metrics snapshot: p50=85ms, p95=420ms, errors=0.12%, infra-SLO=99.95%, active-hosted-customers=4,210.

Sam (CEO): On policy: hosted API logs/token retention reduced from 90d -> 30d for free tier; enterprise unaffected (customer-managed). Compliance and support teams to publish FAQ by Wed.

Priya (VP Product): We'll gate the UI banner to 10% first, then ramp. Draft comms in #marketing for review.

Devon (PM): Can Eng push the latency dashboard to the shared exec folder? Want a simple one-pager for Friday.

Liu (VP Eng): Will publish a trimmed dashboard (p50/p95/errors/throughput) and annotations for the autoscaler deploy.

Sam (CEO): One ask — if you spot any regression that could be customer-impacting, tag #incidents and ping me directly if it looks like >$500 impact or a >0.5% error spike. Appreciate the fast turnaround team. :rocket: 

Priya (VP Product): Thanks all — see you Friday.

Nadia (Head CS): Adding customer outreach owners in the doc now.

ops-bot: Deploy canary scheduled: 2026-04-07T02:00:00Z (eu-dedicated-pool).
